title: Remove Core's documents about features that left it
goal: Documentation reflects reality at all times: every page in Core describes what Core is today, and pages about features that left go, so a stranger reading the public repository is not misled

reuse.searched: Each page was judged against the tree: its subject (does the code still exist in core) and every relative link, repository path, susi command and cargo alias it names. Pages about removed features go whole; the few kept pages are corrected from the code they describe (src/daemon.rs, crates/susi-gmcp). No new code.
